long_description: OneSchema Studio brings AI Cowork into your private cloud. Teams can clean and validate massive datasets at 1,000x the scale of generic AI tools - data never leaves your network, you pick the AI model, and proven work becomes a skill your whole team can reuse. It self-hosts natively on AWS, Azure, or GCP, gives you granular, role-based control over who can touch what data, and connects directly to the systems you already run - from Salesforce and Workday to SAP and Snowflake.
name: OneSchema
one_liner: The AI Cowork for big data
